messages.subject: Re: Package tsDyn - setar function
parts:
Dear Victor,
The function star follows the specification process proposed by Teräsvirta
et al., see [1] for a review. The linearity test is thus an LM (lagrange
multiplier) test against a STAR model.

[1] http://www2.eur.nl/WebDOC/doc/econometrie/feweco20000609141913.pdf

I'm in the process of documenting that function, stay tuned! Salud!

--
José Luis Aznarte M.

parts:
Hello,
 
I am kind of new in using this package and not that strong in programming.
I have encountered a problem with the setar model when searching for an external threshold.
 
-using the selectSETAR function to search for an external threshold i receive the value -0.2, without warnings that the trim procedure is not respected.
 
-using setar function as mod.setar_SSR1<-setar(dnpl_ok,m=2,thDelay=1,thVar=ro[,9])  I obtain the same value for the threshold
 
An error occurs when I use the values obtained by selectSETAR:
mod.setar_SSR1<-setar(dnpl_ok,m=2,thDelay=1,thVar=grid_SSR1$th)
Error in setar(dnpl_ok, m = 2, thDelay = 1, thVar = grid_SSR1$th) :   thVar has not enough/too much observations when taking thDelay
Also when i dont establish in advance the number of lags(m) i receive the following message:
> mod.setar_SSR1<-setar(dnpl_ok,m=1:2,thDelay=0:1,thVar=ro[,9])
Error in structure(c(this, list(...)), class = class(this)) :  subscript out of bounds
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In if ((m * d + steps) > n) stop("time series too small to handle these embedding parameters") :
  the condition has length > 1 and only the first element will be used
2: In 0:(m - 1) : numerical expression has 2 elements: only the first used
3: In 1:m : numerical expression has 2 elements: only the first used
 
Could you give me some tips where i do not procede ok? I am sorry for asking you that but I am blocked to these errors I don`t know what to do further on. 
Thank you very much 
Luminita
